title: Stationary pressure calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the gas pressure when elevator is stationary using p₁ = p₀ - Mg/S.

title: Acceleration determination
description: Important Criteria: Applies Newton's second law to find upward acceleration when tension is maximum: a = [F - (M+m)g]/(M+m).

title: Accelerating pressure calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates gas pressure during upward acceleration using p₂ = p₀ - M(g+a)/S.

title: Boyle's law application
description: Important Criteria: Applies isothermal condition p₁L₁ = p₂L₂ to find maximum distance L₂.

title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential Criteria: Provides correct maximum distance L₂ = 21.25 cm (or equivalent in meters).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Converts all quantities to consistent SI units before calculations.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses incorrect sign in pressure formulas (e.g., p₀ + Mg/S instead of p₀ - Mg/S).

title: Mass inclusion error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly includes piston mass in pressure calculations instead of only cylinder mass.
